purpose: Genuine cross-implementation conformance gate: the NTRU+ authors' own published KAT records.
provenance: Copied verbatim from the ntruplus.org reference implementation's KAT/*/PQCkemKAT_*.rsp files (https://github.com/ntruplus/ntruplus, commit 621c667403215dd41d5336de60f8d02db067d2d4, vendored as the git submodule metamui-crypto-reference/c/ntruplus-ref). Those files are produced by the NIST PQCgenKAT_kem harness: randombytes = AES-256-CTR-DRBG without derivation function, seeded per record with the 48-byte 'seed'; keygen draws randombytes(32) per sampling attempt (f, then g), encaps draws randombytes(N/8). tools/ntru-plus-upstream-gen/genrun.sh rebuilds the reference's generator and refuses to vendor unless its output is byte-identical to the shipped files. NOT self-generated by MetaMUI.
note: The 2026 revision (spec dated 2026-02-02) defines three parameter sets; the 576 set of the 2025 KpqClean revision was dropped. Versus that revision it changed the serialization layout, the CBD/SOTP bit layout, hash_f (SHA-256 -> SHAKE-256) and the Montgomery-domain convention of the NTT-domain values, so no byte of pk/sk/ct/ss is comparable across revisions.
